_comment: Build once, run the app for manual testing, then tidy up. Aimed at the loop of 'change something, look at it, close it'.
platform_refusal: Running the desktop shell needs the Windows WebView2 runtime; the product targets Windows 10/11 (owner decision 2026-07-26).

debug.label: debug build (fast to compile, slow to run)

release.label: release build (slow to compile, what users get)

_frontend_note: The desktop binary embeds the built frontend at compile time, so the bundle has to exist before cargo runs. `tauri dev` would instead start a Vite dev server with hot reload -- use `pnpm desktop:dev` for that. This script exists for testing the real binary, which is a different question.
_cleanup_note: Cleaning after a manual test is opt-in, and 'all' deliberately keeps its confirmation prompt: a testing session is exactly when a developer has uncommitted files lying around.
